title: Ipseic agents, medium term
situation: mav, kino and nico are kept minimal on purpose while the workflow is proven, first in consumer use such as a film-production project. The operator's unstated medium-term goal is agents with selfhood. Industry pieces exist separately: ambient agents (long-running, event-triggered), cryptographic agent identity (key pairs, signed acts, agent cards), persistent self-editing memory, and self-improving agents; nothing combines them into one continuous self.
decision: Design ipseic agents after the workflow is proven in consumer use, with mav, kino and nico among the first. Until then, every factor and composition choice keeps room for them: identity carries a personal identifier slot (name, mark, key), memory distinguishes the agent's own continuous experience from a session's working memory, and nothing ties an agent to one session, host or harness.
consequences: The re-cut (0044) reserves these slots without realizing them; the ipseic design is a later discovery round.
